label: stand 1
title: Stand on your spot
instruction: Stand still on your spot in your guard, facing the camera. The game takes this as your home spot.

label: guard
title: Keep your guard
instruction: Stay on your spot in your normal boxing guard (fists at your chin), bouncing lightly. Do not cover, do not lean.

label: cover
title: Cover your head
instruction: Each time COVER is called, cover your head: both forearms up, gloves against your forehead and temples, elbows in. On GUARD, back to your normal guard.

label: look around
title: Look around
instruction: Stay on your spot in your guard. Turn your head left and right, nod, look down and up. Do not lean, do not step.

label: slip left
title: Slip to the left
instruction: In your guard. Each time you are called, SLIP to your LEFT: lean your head and shoulders left, then come back.

label: slip right
title: Slip to the right
instruction: In your guard. Each time you are called, SLIP to your RIGHT: lean your head and shoulders right, then come back.

label: straight left
title: Straight punches with the left
instruction: In your guard. Each time you are called, throw ONE straight punch (jab) with your LEFT hand at the camera, and back to your guard.

label: straight right
title: Straight punches with the right
instruction: In your guard. Each time you are called, throw ONE straight punch (cross) with your RIGHT hand at the camera, and back to your guard.

label: hook left
title: Hooks with the left
instruction: In your guard. Each time you are called, throw ONE hook with your LEFT hand: swing it across at the height of your chin, and back to your guard.

label: hook right
title: Hooks with the right
instruction: In your guard. Each time you are called, throw ONE hook with your RIGHT hand: swing it across at the height of your chin, and back to your guard.

label: uppercut left
title: Uppercuts with the left
instruction: In your guard. Each time you are called, throw ONE uppercut with your LEFT hand: from below up to the chin, and back to your guard.

label: uppercut right
title: Uppercuts with the right
instruction: In your guard. Each time you are called, throw ONE uppercut with your RIGHT hand: from below up to the chin, and back to your guard.

label: one two
title: One-two
instruction: In your guard. Each time you are called, throw a ONE-TWO: a straight left, then at once a straight right, and back to your guard.

label: knee left
title: Knee strikes with the left
instruction: Each time you are called, pull your LEFT knee up high, as a knee strike, and put it down.

label: knee right
title: Knee strikes with the right
instruction: Each time you are called, pull your RIGHT knee up high, as a knee strike, and put it down.

label: duck
title: Ducks
instruction: Each time you are called, DUCK (squat), and come up again.

label: jump
title: Jumps
instruction: Each time you are called, JUMP with both feet, land softly, and stand again.

label: free
title: Fight freely
instruction: Fight as in the game: punch, kick, slip, duck, jump and cover as you like.

label: stand 2
title: Stand on your spot
instruction: Back on your spot, stand still in your guard.
